native.nf_implementation: Actual installed controller/model or independently qualified implementation, independent of industry.
native.nf_protocol: Actual NFCIP1 or selected tag/card protocol; NFC-A/B/F/V are different RF paths.
native.nf_operation: Actual reader/writer, card emulation or NFCIP1 peer mode, not host connection.
native.nf_mode: Actual passive load-modulated target versus active alternating own fields.
native.nf_role: Actual initiator/target or reader/card. A host I2C master is not an NFC initiator by implication.
native.nf_direction: Actual RF transfer direction, separate from DH/NFCC packet direction.
native.nf_rate_basis: Named rounded RF rate versus exact carrier/divisor. Neither is host I2C/SPI clock.
native.nf_rate_profile: Fully specified NFCIP1 PHY versus higher active divisors needing independently qualified modulation/coding.
native.nf_host: Actual ordered I2C versus SPI hardware interface, not interchangeable software setting.
native.nf_host_direction: Actual NCI direction between devicehost and controller.
native.nf_host_i2c_mode: PN7160 host supports Standard, Fast and High-speed; no automatic Fast-mode-plus.
native.nf_rf_state: Actual selected controller RF-state, idle dynamicNDEF/loopback versus staticRF exchange.
native.nf_logical_kind: Actual staticRF, dynamicNDEF or loopback connection; not multiple simultaneous RF capacities.
native.nf_dep_pdu: Actual NFCIP1 DEP Information, ACK/NACK, protected or supervisory, with own header/size semantics.
native.nf_coding: Actual direction/protocol/rate coding; no universal Manchester or CAN bit stuffing.
native.nf_device_source: Actual model/firmware/capability evidence; a catalog entry is not installed device proof.
native.nf_mapping_source: Actual RF role, peer/tag, activation, selected protocol and encoding agreement.
native.nf_physical_source: Actual antenna tuning/operating volume/field/tolerance/regulatory measurements. No guaranteed distance from generic NFC label.
native.nf_schedule_source: Actual activation, anticollision, whole RF/host exchanges, retries and application timing bound.
native.nf_acceptance_source: Actual application/security/deadline/freshness acceptance, not certified by an RF rate.
native.nf_registered_source: Actual selected alternative implementation/protocol/extendedPHY source and revision.
native.nf_host_source: Actual ordered interface, pins, clocks, IRQ/NSS/wake and driver behavior.
native.nf_firmware_hex: Actual firmware triplet as six hex digits, e.g.12500a means displayed12.50.0A, not decimal18.80.10.
native.nf_reset_ntf_hex: Actual PN7160/PN7161 CORE_RESET_NTF; byte9 model and10..12 firmware. Header/disposition still actual.
native.nf_nci_hex: Actual host NCI packet including3-byte header and payload; not over-air NFC frame.
native.nf_connection_source: Actual CORE_INIT/activation/connection result and current credits/max payload, not universal255 application bytes.
native.nf_transaction_source: Actual uninterrupted request/response state, chaining/PSL/PNI and bounds.
native.nf_security_source: Actual NFC-SEC or tag/application authentication and protected encoding; CRC does not provide authenticity.
native.nf_field_qualification_source: Actual physical field limits/positions qualification; ECMA8.2 contains Hmin/Hmin wording ambiguity, no silent correction.
native.nf_ecp_authorization_source: Actual formal Apple ECP authorization when selected PN7161 feature used; no fabricated authorization.
native.nf_carrier_hz: Actual nominal13.56MHz carrier, measured deviation qualified separately.
native.nf_divisor: Actual carrier divisor128/64/32; selected PN7160 reader A/B adds16, V512.
native.nf_bit_duration_us: Exact carrier/divisor bit duration distinct rounded named rate.
native.nf_model_id: Actual reset modelID0x61 PN7160 or0x71 PN7161.
native.nf_fw_rom: Actual firmware ROM hex octet0x12=18 decimal on qualified12.50 firmware branch.
native.nf_fw_major: Actual major hex octet0x50=80 decimal, not50 decimal.
native.nf_fw_patch: Actual patch hex octet0x0A=10; P2P/typeF legacy availability stops after0A.
native.nf_host_clock_bps: Actual DH-driven I2C/SPI clock rate, separate NFC RF bitrate.
native.nf_host_address_bits: Actual I2C address width: PN7160 sevenbit, not tenbit.
native.nf_host_address: Actual strapped sevenbit28..2Bhex; no automatic actual address28.
native.nf_host_write_address: Actual eightbit address byte adds low R/W=0; not sevenbit slave identity.
native.nf_host_read_address: Actual eightbit address byte adds low R/W=1.
native.nf_host_spi_mode: Actual supported CPOL/CPHA SPI mode0..3; PN7160 halfduplex even with separateMOSI/MISO.
native.nf_spi_direction_octet: Actual transfer detector0xxxxxxx write orFF read; additional host byte not RF overhead.
native.nf_host_extra_octets: Actual I2C adds0/SPIadds1 transfer direction byte, excluding electrical address/ACK/clocks.
native.nf_host_bytes: Actual NCI packet plus host mapping prefix; not whole I2C START/address/ACK bound.
native.nf_nci_header0: Actual first NCI headeroctet: MTbits7..5, PBFbit4, GID/control orConnID/data low4.
native.nf_nci_pbf: Actual packet boundaryflag1 means notfinal;0 complete orlastfragment.
native.nf_nci_gid: Actual control groupID fourbits; definedopcode/source required, not all0..15groups implemented.
native.nf_nci_oid: Actual control opcode sixbits; supportedopcode qualified independently.
native.nf_nci_conn_id: Actual data connectionID fourbits, not IP endpoint.
native.nf_nci_length: Actual8bit payload length, mayzero; not applicationlength or RF frame length.
native.nf_nci_packet_bytes: Actual3-byte header plus NCI payload0..255, max258.
native.nf_max_control_payload: Actual initialization-reported maxcontrol packet payload, not universal negotiated value.
native.nf_mapping_mtu: Actual optional NCI transport MTU includes header; packet must fit, fragmentation perlogicalconnection.
native.nf_credits: Actual available credits on selected connection; PN7160 limitedto1, zero means wait.
native.nf_dynamic_connections: Actual PN7160 atmostone additional dynamic connection; no universalNFCCcount.
native.nf_dep_len: Actual NFCIP1 transport LEN3..255 counts two CMDbytes, Byte1..n and LENitself; excludes RFCRC/preamble.
native.nf_dep_body_bytes: Actual NFCIP1 Byte1..n includingPFB/optionalDID/NAD, not solely userbytes.
native.nf_dep_lr: Actual negotiated LR0..3 gives Byte1..n limit64/128/192/252.
native.nf_dep_body_limit: Actual negotiated Byte1..n length limit fromLR, not advertisedNCI255.
native.nf_dep_pfb: Actual PFB fromtype/chaining/DID/NAD/PNI; reserved forms rejected.
native.nf_dep_pni: Actual peractivatedtarget packet number0..3; initial0 not globalcounter acrossdevices.
native.nf_dep_did: Actual NFCIP1 deviceidentifier where used; range determined by selectedactivation, actualsource.
native.nf_dep_nad: Actual optional nodeaddress octet, not inferredfromIP.
native.nf_dep_data_bytes: Actual information/protected/supervisory data bytes distinct DEP header and NFC application chain.
native.nf_dep_header_bytes: Actual PFB1 plus optionalDID/NAD; protectedsecurity format separatequalification.
native.nf_wt: Actual target waitingtime exponent0..14;15reserved, default14 proposal only NFCIP1.
native.nf_response_wait_us: Actual tRW4096/fc*2^WT measured between rate-specific modulation edges; rounded302us not exact.
native.nf_extended_wait_us: Actual intermediate wait=min(tRW*RTOX,tRW_MAX), only target extension procedure.
native.nf_initial_delay_us: Actual initialRFCA tIDT strictlygreater4096/fc, not rounded302us.
native.nf_rf_preamble_bits: Actual passive212/424NFCIP1 minimum48Manchester zero bits; not allNFCframes.
native.nf_field_a_m: Actual physical field measurement at declared operatingposition, no implicit rangeguarantee.
native.nf_field_threshold_a_m: Nominal externalfielddetect threshold0.1875A/m forNFCIP1; actualqualifieddetector distinct.
native.nf_carrier_tolerance_hz: Actual qualified oscillator/regulatorycarrier tolerance; datasheet contrasts7000HzISOand100ppmFCC.
native.nf_operating_distance_mm: Actual qualified operatingvolume/range; no universal20mm/100mm default.
native.nf_vddpad_v: Actual selectedIOrail either1.65..1.95 or3.0..3.6V, not continuousrange.
native.nf_host_follower_only: Actual PN7160host is followeronly; DH drivesclock.
native.nf_dep_did_present: Actual DEP header containsDID; actualmappedactivation separate.
native.nf_psl_during_data: Actual PN7160speed change duringdatatransfer prohibited; PSLselection earlier.
native.nf_mode_changed: Actual NFCIP1active/passive mode change midtransaction prohibited.
native.bitrate: Actual nominal RF mode label or exact13.56MHz/divisor; role/protocol/installedfirmware distinct fromhostI2C/SPI rate. No universal424k default.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded application bytes maychain overmultipleRF/NCI frames. NCI255, DEPbody252/LEN255 andapplicationlength differ. No fixed8byte oruniversal255bytepayload default.
